INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors Mage build

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Mage has the fastest screen-clear in the alpha and three strong capstones, but no pet to hide behind. Frostbite plus Shatter is the community S-tier shell. Play it if you already know enemy movement; the class punishes a missed reposition more than any other ranged pick.

Build phases

0–3 min

Take Blizzard or another area spell immediately to keep the wave under control.

3–8 min

Commit to Frostbite / Shatter and one survival tool; protect room to reposition.

8–15 min

Rank up the carry and cooldown reduction. Boss control resistance makes extra slows a lower priority.

Boss notes

There is no pet to hide behind. Move before the wave closes and use open burst windows instead of relying on control chains.

Common mistakes

Taking another damage multiplier before a survival buffer. Missing a reposition. Assuming wave-clear makes the boss harmless.

Skill priority

  • Blizzard or early area coverage.
  • Frostbite / Shatter shell.
  • One survival buffer.
  • Carry rank-ups and cooldown reduction.

Passive priority

  1. Blessing of Might — +10% all damage per rank, +50% at rank 5. It helps every build; take it first.
  2. Arcane Intellect — 8% faster recharge per rank, 40% at rank 5, total capped at 65%.
  3. Amplify Magic — +10% area size per rank, +50% at rank 5. Huge for Flamestrike, Consecration, Volley.
  4. Blessing of Wisdom — +8% experience per rank, +40% at rank 5. Take it early or not at all.
  5. Power Word: Fortitude — +20% max health per rank, +100% at rank 5. Buffer on squishier classes.
  • See the full passive priority and stat caps

FAQ

Is Mage a good first-clear choice?

Read the Mage trade-off above and the tier list. Warrior or Paladin remains the forgiving first-clear starting point.

What should I take in the first three minutes?

Take Blizzard or another area spell immediately to keep the wave under control.

When should I spend rerolls?

Use the level 6–12 commitment window, rather than spending rerolls in the first three levels.

What is the main Mage mistake?

Taking another damage multiplier before a survival buffer. Missing a reposition. Assuming wave-clear makes the boss harmless.
